name: agent-qa
summary: Local web and mobile QA for coding agents, with persistent memidex memory, validated self-improvement and step evidence.
description: Runs plain-language end-to-end tests against web, Android and iOS interfaces through a local CLI or MCP. Persistent memidex memory reuses validated lessons across runs; updates remain reviewable files. A local dashboard shows run steps and screenshots. FSL-1.1-ALv2; local software is free for permitted use, with model inference and execution infrastructure supplied separately.

agent_access.notes: Test execution uses a local CLI or MCP with a configured model and target environment. The public website and its documentation MCP are read-only and cannot execute tests.
